summary: {clerk} retrieves both offices' answers when the same complaint comes back.
realLife: The Merced procedure required the county to keep written complaints, appeals and both offices' responses for at least three years.
gates: The county has a prior written complaint and an appeal for the same incident.
inGame: needs: the original case number and both offices' dated correspondence.

turns.what: The manager checks its promised remedy against the appeal.
turns.pulledBy: The file contains the original reply.
turns.writesBack: The review cites the earlier commitment.

turns.what: The clerk requests a copy from the issuing office.
turns.pulledBy: A response is missing from the folder.
turns.writesBack: The file shows which document is outstanding.
